ella: Quick heads-up: the API ref for /v1/embeddings has a couple of inconsistencies I ran into while helping a customer. The request schema shows `input: string | string[]` but the Python example uses `inputs` (plural) while the curl/JS examples use `input`. We should pick one canonical shape and add a migration note.

mike: oh nice catch. Server accepts both, but the SDK expects `input` (singular) for single-item calls and `inputs` for batch. Docs should be explicit about both forms.

vera: proposing we: 1) update the schema block to show both forms with examples, 2) make the curl/JS snippets consistently use `inputs: ["..."]` to encourage batching, and 3) add a short paragraph under "Request examples" explaining single vs batch usage and how SDKs map to those shapes.

ash: small practical thing	6: the JS snippet currently does `const res = await client.embeddings.create({ input: '...' })` which is fine, but our generated SDK docs treat `input` as required and that contradicts the schema showing `input?` for streaming/batched endpoints. Can we align the TypeScript defs and examples so linter and typed examples match?

ella: yes. I'll update the TS defs to `input?: string; inputs?: string[]` and add a one-line comment in the JS/TS snippets recommending `inputs` for multi-item requests.

mike: also found one broken link: the embeddings page links to `/guides/embeddings/best-practices` but the correct slug is `/guides/embeddings/best-practices-v2`. Small follow-up PR to fix that.

vera: for the examples, prefer showing batching because it's more production-friendly. Example payload: `{ "inputs": ["query A", "query B"] }`. For single-item examples show the SDK idiomatic call, not raw JSON.

ash: linting note: run `./scripts/snippet-lint` after edits. We had a CI false negative where examples had trailing commas in JSON blocks which made the fenced snippets invalid.

ella: plan: open one PR that updates schema block, all examples (curl/JS/Python/Go) to use `inputs` by default, add a short paragraph explaining single-item `input` vs batch `inputs`, update TS defs, and fix the broken guide link in a tiny follow-up if reviewers prefer. PR will be #1105 and I'll tag you all.

docs-bot: Draft PR created by ella: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1105 (WIP)

mike: will review after lint passes. thanks! :thumbsup:
